query: I'm upgrading my workout gear and need to order everything to arrive quickly. To go with them, I need a specific item with 'Compression Mock' in the name that has over 850 five-star reviews, less than 10 one-star reviews, and can also be delivered in under 2 days. I also need to find a popular white item with more than 250 five-star ratings and a monthly sales volume over 100. Next, I need something in camel with more than 5 three-star reviews that also ships in less than 2 days. I am also looking for an olive green product with fewer than 10 one-star reviews and a transport time of less than 5 days. Finally, I need one last item with a stock quantity over 20, an average rating score above 4.5, fewer than 5 three-star reviews, and a transport time of less than 2 days. Please help me find options that fall within a budget of 18875 to 19997.
